Objective: Verify the basic end-to-end execution flow on gemm_top_l2 (M=16, K=32, N=16, k_dim=32, out_mode=2'b01 INT8-only): from start_i=1 pulse -> loading PRAM parameter table -> fetching A/B via MM2S -> computing on gemm_compute_core -> storing into C_ACCUM -> 7-stage requantization -> S2MM row-wise write (row_mode_w=1) -> receiving s2mm_sts -> asserting done_o=1.
Stimulus: Initialize simulated DDR memory with A[16][32], B[32][16], and a 16-channel requantization parameter table (256 bytes at base_param); set lda=32, ldb=16, ldc=16, out_mode=2'b01; assert start_i=1 for 1 clock cycle.
Checks: Verify busy_o asserts to 1 immediately after start_i and drops to 0 on the exact cycle done_o pulses to 1 (1 cycle); err_o=0; verify DDR memory at base_c[0..255] matches the golden result C8 = requant(A*B) 100% byte-for-byte.
Expected_result: Completes without error (err_o=0, done_o=1); all 256 INT8 bytes in DDR match the Golden Model 100%.
Notes: Verifies coordination across all 4 FSMs: Fetch (F_*), Generator (G_*), Compute/Recv (C_*), and Writer (row_mode_w).
Bug_Injection_Target: Corrupting p_addr_w or failing to start generator G_* -> system hangs or produces wrong output -> TB reports FAIL.
Pass_Criteria: 256/256 C8 bytes match golden; err_o==0; done_o pulses for exactly 1 cycle.

Objective: Verify all 3 valid output modes of cfg_out_mode_i: 2'b01 (INT8-only write using row_mode_w=1), 2'b10 (raw INT32-only tile write using W_CMD32/W_DATA32, skipping PRAM parameter fetch entirely), and 2'b11 (simultaneous dual write of both INT8 and INT32 via W_CMD->W_DATA->W_CMD32->W_DATA32).
Stimulus: Using the same matrices A[32][64] and B[64][32] (k_dim=32), sequentially run 3 jobs with cfg_out_mode_i = 2'b01, 2'b10, and 2'b11 into separate base_c and base_c32 DDR buffers.
Checks: In mode 2'b10: confirm the fetch FSM NEVER enters F_P_CMD/F_P_DATA (no reads from base_param) and base_c32 matches the raw INT32 product A*B (little-endian) 100%. In mode 2'b11: confirm both base_c (INT8) and base_c32 (INT32) regions are written completely and match golden.
Expected_result: All 3 modes (2'b01, 2'b10, 2'b11) write the exact format, target addresses, and expected number of S2MM commands (s2mm_sts_expected_r).
Notes: Mode 2'b01 uses the optimized row_mode_w path (line 835, 1 S2MM command per full block row N<=256), whereas modes 2'b10 and 2'b11 use the per-16-column-tile W_CMD/W_CMD32 FSM (line 866).
Golden_Reference_Rule: Mode 01: C8=requant(A*B); Mode 10: C32=A*B (0 PRAM DMA); Mode 11: both C8 and C32 match.
Bug_Injection_Target: Removing the out_int8_w guard when asserting p_req_r at lines 771/801 -> mode 2'b10 falsely fetches base_param -> TB detects redundant MM2S command.
Pass_Criteria: 100% of C8 bytes and C32 words match golden across all 3 modes; 0 PRAM reads in mode 2'b10.

Objective: Verify the hardware configuration checker cfg_ok_w across all 14 invalid configuration cases: it must reject execution immediately (issuing zero DMA commands), assert err_o=1 with a 1-cycle done_o=1 pulse, and automatically clear err_o=0 when a subsequent valid job starts.
Stimulus: Run 14 start_i=1 triggers, each intentionally violating exactly 1 condition in cfg_ok_w: (1) M=0; (2) N=0; (3) K=0; (4) k_dim=0; (5) k_dim=48 (not a power of 2); (6) k_dim=512 (>256); (7) out_mode=2'b00; (8) base_a[3:0]!=0; (9) base_b[3:0]!=0; (10) lda[3:0]!=0 or lda < ceil16(K); (11) ldb[3:0]!=0 or ldb < ceil16(N); (12) out_mode[0]=1 with 16B-unaligned base_c/ldc/base_param or ldc < N; (13) out_mode[1]=1 with 16B-unaligned base_c32/ldc32 or ldc32 < 4*N; (14) Follow with a 15th valid configuration.
Checks: In all 14 invalid runs: verify that on the cycle immediately following start_i=1, err_o asserts to 1, done_o pulses to 1 for 1 cycle, busy_o stays 0, mm2s_cmd_tvalid==0, and s2mm_cmd_tvalid==0. On the 15th valid run: err_o clears to 0 upon start_i and computation succeeds.
Expected_result: All 14/14 invalid configurations are safely blocked with err_o=1, done_o=1, and 0 DMA transactions; the 15th run recovers err_o=0 cleanly.
Notes: Prevents the FPGA from ever issuing 16-byte-unaligned DMA commands that would hard-hang the AXI DataMover IP (since DRE is disabled in DataMover).
Golden_Reference_Rule: When !cfg_ok_w && start_i: err_o<=1, done_o<=1, busy_o==0, 0 DMA commands.
Bug_Injection_Target: Omitting any condition in cfg_ok_w (lines 138-148) -> the corresponding violation fails to assert err_o=1 -> TB reports FAIL.
Pass_Criteria: 14/14 error cases assert err_o=1 & done_o=1 on the next cycle; 0 DMA commands issued.

Category: Boundary Dimension - Small M (Decode M=1 & M=3)
Objective: Verify M smaller than the 16x16 array size (specifically M=1 for LLM Decode, M=3 for 3-Digit Fallback, and M=15): hardware must fetch only M rows of A and write only M rows of C/C32 to DDR without overwriting rows M..15.
Stimulus: Pre-fill destination C and C32 DDR regions with canary bytes (8'hAA). Run M = 1, 3, 15 sequentially with K = 64, N = 32, k_dim = 32 in both out_mode = 2'b01 and 2'b11.
Checks: Verify the number of MM2S commands reading A equals exactly M per K-block (a_cmd_row_r < f_mv_w = M); verify in C and C32 DDR memory that only rows 0..M-1 are updated while rows M and above retain the 8'hAA canary bytes.
Expected_result: Results on rows 0..M-1 match golden 100%; rows >= M are untouched (0 canary bytes overwritten).
Notes: Directly models the LLM Decode phase (M=1) and 3-digit fallback (M=3), which account for >90% of PL invocations on the KR260 board.
Golden_Reference_Rule: Rows of A read = M; rows of C/C32 written = M; DDR[row >= M] == 8'hAA.
Bug_Injection_Target: Setting the writer loop bound to a multiple of 16 rows instead of c_mv_w (lines 827, 844, 857, 925) -> overwrites 15 garbage rows into DDR when M=1 -> canary check catches it immediately.
Pass_Criteria: 0 canary bytes outside [0..M-1] modified; all M rows match 100%.

Category: Boundary Dimension - Odd K & Masking Garbage Immunity
Objective: Verify K-dimension masking (a_mask_d1_r = (a_col_k_r < g_kv_r) at line 390) and K-tail chunk truncation (nch_tail_w at line 249) when K is not divisible by 16 or k_dim (K = 1, 15, 17, 33, 70 with k_dim = 32).
Stimulus: Set M=16, N=16, k_dim=32; sweep K across {1, 15, 17, 33, 70}. In DDR memory for both matrix A (columns K to lda-1) and matrix B (rows K to 255), intentionally fill padding regions with extreme garbage values (+127 and -128) instead of zeros.
Checks: Verify that because a_mask_d1_r forces core_a_tdata_w to 8'd0 when a_col_k_r >= g_kv_r (line 332), all garbage bytes at columns k >= K of A and rows k >= K of B are multiplied by 0 and do not affect the accumulator; also verify the number of chunks sent to the compute core is ceil(K / k_dim) rather than 256/k_dim.
Expected_result: C8 and C32 results match 100% with the sum over k=0..K-1, even when DDR padding bytes are filled with +-127/-128 garbage.
coverage_target: cg_dim_k: k_eq_1, k_lt_16, k_gt_16_lt_kdim, k_unaligned_multi_chunk, garbage_in_padding (100%)
Notes: On the KR260 board, when slicing matrices or using stride lda > K, trailing bytes from K to ceil16(K)-1 in DDR may contain non-zero data.
Golden_Reference_Rule: C32[m][n] = sum_{k=0}^{K-1} A[m][k]*B[k][n] (invariant to A[m][k>=K] and B[k>=K][n]).
Bug_Injection_Target: Hardwiring a_mask_d1_r = 1'b1 at line 390 -> garbage bytes in columns K..ceil16(K)-1 are accumulated into the result -> TB reports FAIL immediately.
Pass_Criteria: 100% of results are immune to out-of-bound K padding garbage.

Category: Boundary Dimension - Odd N & Partial S2MM tkeep
Objective: Verify writing odd column counts N not divisible by 16 (and not divisible by 4 for INT32): check the s2mm_tkeep byte mask (keep8_w and keep32(nt, k)) and the S2MM command BTT field to ensure only the N valid columns are written without touching columns N..ldc-1.
Stimulus: Fill destination C and C32 DDR buffers completely with 8'hCC canary bytes. Run M=4, K=32, k_dim=32 with N swept across: 1, 3, 4, 5, 7, 12, 15, 17, 23 (covering nb32_w = 1, 2, 3, 4 INT32 beats and remainders nt % 4 = 1, 2, 3, 0) across all 3 modes out_mode = 2'b01, 2'b10, 2'b11.
Checks: For each row m: verify columns 0..N-1 in DDR receive the exact C8[m][0..N-1] and C32[m][0..N-1] values; verify from byte N of each C8 row (and byte 4*N of each C32 row) through the end of stride ldc/ldc32 that 100% of the 8'hCC canary bytes remain intact.
Expected_result: All odd N values (1, 3, 4, 5, 7, 12, 15, 17, 23) write every valid byte accurately and preserve every canary byte from column N onward.
Notes: Directly verifies keep8_w (lines 545/851), keep32 (lines 548-558), and INT32 beat count nb32_w = (nt_r + 3) >> 2 (line 541).
Golden_Reference_Rule: For each row: only columns 0..N-1 are written; bytes from column N to ldc-1 retain canary 8'hCC.
Bug_Injection_Target: Hardwiring s2mm_tkeep_r = 16'hFFFF at line 851 or 901/916 -> trailing columns N..15 overwrite canary memory -> canary check reports FAIL immediately.
Pass_Criteria: 0 canary bytes overwritten across all odd N values; valid data matches 100%.

Objective: Verify reading and writing sub-matrices stored with row strides larger than the active matrix width (lda > ceil16(K), ldb > ceil16(N), ldc > ceil16(N), ldc32 > 4*ceil16(N)).
Stimulus: Configure M=20, K=36 (ceil16=48), N=20 (ceil16=32) with 1.5x/2x larger strides: lda=96, ldb=64, ldc=64, ldc32=128. Fill inter-row gaps of A and B with noise data and fill inter-row gaps of C and C32 with 8'h5A canary bytes.
Checks: Verify MM2S command addresses step by +lda (96B) per A row and +ldb (64B) per B row, while S2MM command addresses step by +ldc (64B) per C row and +ldc32 (128B) per C32 row; inter-row canary regions in C/C32 remain untouched.
Expected_result: The 20x20 sub-matrix result is 100% accurate at the strided locations; inter-row padding memory is completely preserved.
Notes: Enables the C++ runtime to slice large matrices (such as the 156,032-column lm_head) or execute 2D sub-tensors in-place without repacking in RAM.
Golden_Reference_Rule: Addr_A(m,k) = base_a + m*lda + k; Addr_C(m,n) = base_c + m*ldc + n.
Bug_Injection_Target: Using k_ceil16_w instead of cfg_lda_i when advancing to the next row address -> reads/writes wrong row offsets from row 1 onward -> TB reports FAIL.
Pass_Criteria: 100% of elements match golden; 0 inter-row canary bytes corrupted.

Objective: Verify L2 C_ACCUM (UltraRAM 4096x512b) accumulation across multiple K-blocks (K > 256) including both exact multiples of 256 (K=512 = 2 full blocks) and K with a K-tail remainder (K=300 = 256 + 44, k_dim=32 -> block 0 has c_nch_r=8, block 1 has c_nch_r=2), while verifying requant parameter prefetching (p_req_r/p_ack_r) on the final K-block.
Stimulus: Run M=32, N=32, k_dim=32 with K=300 (out_mode=2'b11). Monitor c_k_0_d1_r (line 443), c_nch_r (lines 768, 790), and p_req_r/p_ack_r (lines 801, 814).
Checks: Verify on K-block 0 (c_k_blk_cnt_r==0): C_ACCUM overwrites with new values (c_k_0_d1_r=1), c_nch_r=8, and p_req_r=0 (PRAM not fetched yet). When advancing to K-block 1 (c_k_blk_cnt_r==1 == k_blk_last_w): c_nch_r updates to nch_tail_w=2, p_req_r asserts to 1 so the fetch FSM prefetches PRAM while the compute core processes K-block 1, and C_ACCUM accumulates (c_k_0_d1_r=0) K-block 1 into K-block 0.
Expected_result: Accumulation across both K-blocks (256 + 44 = 300 K steps) is 100% accurate on both C8 and C32; PRAM is fetched exactly once during the final K-block.
Notes: Verifies coordination between the L1 accumulator (post_accumulator within a K-block) and L2 accumulator (C_ACCUM URAM across K-blocks) along with early c_nch_r <= nch_next_w update at line 790.
Golden_Reference_Rule: C32 = sum_{kb=0}^{1} sum_{k in kb} A*B; PRAM DMA triggers only when c_k_blk_cnt_r == k_blk_last_w.
Bug_Injection_Target: Omitting c_nch_r <= nch_next_w at line 790 (leaving c_nch_r=8 for a tail K-block with only 2 chunks) -> post_accumulator waits forever for 6 non-existent chunks causing deadlock -> watchdog timeout catches it immediately.
Pass_Criteria: Completes on time; C8 and C32 match golden 100% for both K=300 and K=512.

Objective: Verify full 3D tiling loops when M, K, and N all exceed 256 (e.g., M=272, K=288, N=272 with k_dim=64 -> 2x2x2 = 8 L2 blocks, comprising leading 256x256 blocks and a 16x32x16 boundary block).
Stimulus: Initialize matrices A[272][288], B[288][272], and a 272-channel requantization parameter table (channels 0..255 in N-block 0 have distinct parameters from channels 256..271 in N-block 1). Run with k_dim=64, out_mode=2'b11.
Checks: Verify block traversal order (K innermost -> N middle -> M outermost) stays synchronized across f_*_blk_cnt_r (Fetch), g_*_blk_r (Generator), and c_*_blk_cnt_r (Compute); verify that when advancing to N-block 1 (c_n_blk_cnt_r=1), parameter fetch address p_addr_w advances by +4096 bytes (1 << (LOG2BLK+4) at line 571) to load the final 16 channels (256..271).
Expected_result: All 272x272 = 73,984 elements of both C8 and C32 match the Golden Model 100% bit-exact, including channels 256..271 using the second N-block's requantization parameters.
Notes: Verifies all block address step formulas r_a_mblk_step_w, r_b_kblk_step_w, r_c_mblk_step_w, r_c32_mblk_step_w, and p_addr_w.
Golden_Reference_Rule: 100% match across the entire 272x272 matrix for both C8 and C32.
Bug_Injection_Target: Forgetting to add offset (c_n_blk_cnt_r << 12) to p_addr_w at line 571 or failing to assert p_req_r on a new N-block -> columns 256..271 reuse scale/bias from columns 0..15 -> TB reports FAIL.
Pass_Criteria: 73,984/73,984 C8 and C32 elements match bit-exact 100%.

Category: v7 Feed-Ahead Generator & Ping-Pong GBUF Slot Arbitration
Objective: Verify the v7 Feed-Ahead architecture (Generator G_* decoupled from C_RECV, releasing buf_ready_r[g_sel_r]<=0 early in G_FIN so Fetch can overlap loading the next K-block into ping-pong GBUF) and test the 4-phase p_req_r/p_ack_r handshake corner where Fetch reaches F_DONE before Compute asserts p_req_r.
Stimulus: Run a 1-K-block or 2-K-block job (M=32, K=256, N=32, k_dim=32, out_mode=2'b01) with zero-latency MM2S data delivery so Fetch finishes loading all A/B data and enters F_DONE before Compute requests PRAM (exercising the F_DONE branch at line 716: else if (p_req_r && !p_ack_r) p_ret_done_r <= 1'b1; fetch_state_r <= F_P_CMD).
Checks: Verify both PRAM service branches of the Fetch FSM: from F_WAIT_SLOT (p_ret_done_r=0 -> returns to F_WAIT_SLOT) and from F_DONE (p_ret_done_r=1 -> returns to F_DONE after F_P_DATA); verify Generator G_RUN streams tiles (ga_ni_r, ga_mi_r) continuously without waiting for C_RECV.
Expected_result: Zero deadlock in C_PWAIT (waiting for p_ack_r) regardless of whether Fetch is in F_WAIT_SLOT or F_DONE; ping-pong GBUF slots 0 and 1 alternate properly.
Notes: Lines 716-718 (servicing p_req_r when fetch_state_r is already in F_DONE) cover a subtle corner case: if p_req_r were only checked in F_WAIT_SLOT, a single-K-block job or fast DMA would reach F_DONE and ignore p_req_r, hanging Compute in C_PWAIT forever!
Golden_Reference_Rule: p_req_r is always acknowledged by p_ack_r in both F_WAIT_SLOT and F_DONE.
Bug_Injection_Target: Removing the else if (p_req_r && !p_ack_r) branch in F_DONE (lines 716-718) -> system deadlocks in C_PWAIT -> TB watchdog timeout catches it immediately.
Pass_Criteria: 0 deadlocks; both p_ret_done_r=0 and p_ret_done_r=1 branches achieve 100% coverage.

Category: Drain Producer-Writer Credit FIFO & Command-Before-Data Rule
Objective: Verify the 16-entry credit throttling mechanism (credit_ok_w: occ_r < 16) between the Producer (reading C_ACCUM + driving the 7-stage requant pipeline) and the Writer during C_DRAIN, as well as the cmd_ok_w rule (line 526): the first data beat of each row MUST NEVER be emitted on s2mm_tdata before that row's s2mm_cmd is accepted by DMA.
Stimulus: Run M=64, K=32, N=64, out_mode=2'b01 (row_mode_w=1). During C_DRAIN: Scenario A: hold s2mm_cmd_tready=0 for 30 cycles while s2mm_tready=1 (verify s2mm_tvalid does not assert before the S2MM command is accepted, and when occ_r reaches 16 the Producer halts iss_fire_w=0 without overflowing i8_mem[0:15]). Scenario B: hold s2mm_tready=0 for 30 cycles while s2mm_cmd_tready=1.
Checks: Verify SVA checks: (1) occ_r never exceeds 16; (2) i8_cnt_w and raw_cnt_w never overflow (>16); (3) at the first beat of each row (wr_ni_r==0), the number of rows that have started sending data (wr_start_r) is always <= the number of handshaked S2MM commands (wc_acc_r).
Expected_result: No row in i8_mem/raw_mem is overwritten when the Writer is stalled; the S2MM command always precedes or coincides with the first data beat of its row; the 64x64 result is 100% accurate.
Notes: Without credit_ok_w (occ_r < 16), when s2mm_tready=0, the 7 in-flight rows inside the requant_pc pipeline would overflow i8_mem[0:15] as they drain out!
Golden_Reference_Rule: occ_r <= 16 always holds; wc_acc_r > wr_start_r before emitting the first beat of a new row.
Bug_Injection_Target: Removing cmd_ok_w at line 528 or forcing credit_ok_w = 1'b1 at line 515 -> data emitted before command or i8_mem overflow corrupts output -> SVA and TB report FAIL.
Pass_Criteria: 0 SVA violations; 4,096/4,096 output bytes match golden.

Objective: Verify state C_WAIT_STS (line 959): the PL core may assert done_o=1 and deassert busy_o=0 ONLY after receiving ALL expected S2MM status response packets (s2mm_sts_received_r == s2mm_sts_expected_r) from AXI DataMover, guaranteeing all data has been committed to DDR before notifying the CPU.
Stimulus: Run M=16, K=32, N=32 in out_mode=2'b11 (generating 32 INT8 S2MM commands + 32 INT32 S2MM commands = 64 S2MM commands). Configure the TB DataMover model to hold back the final 5 s2mm_sts_tvalid packets and release them 100 cycles after the final S2MM data beat completes.
Checks: Verify across all 100 cycles while waiting for the final 5 status packets: compute_state_r remains in C_WAIT_STS, busy_o stays 1, and done_o stays 0; on the exact cycle the 64th status packet is received, the FSM transitions to C_DONE_ST and pulses done_o=1 on the following cycle.
Expected_result: done_o never asserts prematurely while any s2mm_sts packet is still outstanding; pulses done_o once immediately after the final status packet arrives.
Notes: On real KR260 hardware, when the final beat leaves gemm_top_l2, data is still buffered inside AXI DataMover and AXI SmartConnect FIFOs. Asserting done_o at the end of C_DRAIN without C_WAIT_STS would cause the ARM CPU to read stale DDR memory before writes complete!
Golden_Reference_Rule: done_o asserts to 1 only after s2mm_sts_received_r == s2mm_sts_expected_r.
Bug_Injection_Target: Jumping directly from C_NEXT_BLOCK to C_DONE_ST (bypassing C_WAIT_STS at line 956) -> done_o asserts 100 cycles early before s2mm_sts arrives -> TB reports FAIL.
Pass_Criteria: busy_o==1 throughout the 100-cycle status delay; done_o==1 right after the 64th status packet.

Objective: Apply simultaneous random back-pressure across all 5 AXI-Stream interfaces connected to DataMover: mm2s_cmd_tready, mm2s_tvalid (with variable command-to-data latency), s2mm_cmd_tready, s2mm_tready, and s2mm_sts_tvalid.
Stimulus: Run a multi-block problem (M=40, K=300, N=40, k_dim=32) in both out_mode=2'b01 and 2'b11 while randomly throttling all 5 channels every cycle (ready/valid probability 20%..50%) combined with 25-cycle long stall bursts.
Checks: Check AXI-Stream SVA assertions on all master ports (mm2s_cmd, s2mm_cmd, s2mm_data): whenever tvalid=1 && tready=0, tdata/tkeep/tlast must remain stable; no beat or command is dropped or duplicated; final DDR output matches 100%.
Expected_result: 0 AXI-Stream protocol violations on any port; 40x40 output matrix matches bit-exact 100%.
coverage_target: cg_dma_bp: mm2s_cmd_bp, mm2s_data_gaps, s2mm_cmd_bp, s2mm_data_bp, s2mm_sts_delayed, all_combined (100%)
Notes: Simulates real DDR4 bus contention on Zynq UltraScale+ when both PS (4 ARM cores) and PL DMA access memory concurrently.
Golden_Reference_Rule: All AXIS transactions obey (tvalid && tready) handshaking; DDR results match golden.
Bug_Injection_Target: Any desynchronization between command counters and data beat counters under skewed cmd_tready and data_tready is exposed.
Pass_Criteria: 0 SVA errors; 1,600/1,600 C8 and C32 elements match golden.

Objective: Verify matrix shapes directly representing real Qwen2-Audio model layers from report_all.json (scaled down in block count for fast simulation while preserving exact M, K, N boundary characteristics of Encoder, Prefill, and Decode).
Stimulus: Run a suite of 5 representative shapes: (1) Decode GEMV M=1, K=256, N=288; (2) 3-Digit Fallback M=3, K=288, N=256; (3) Odd LLM Prefill M=49, K=128, N=144; (4) Audio Encoder chunk M=64, K=160, N=160; (5) Odd 3D tail M=19, K=275, N=37 with k_dim=32 and real requantization parameters from scales_P15.
Checks: Compare C8 and C32 results in DDR against the Golden Model across all 5 layer shapes.
Expected_result: All 5 representative Qwen2-Audio shapes achieve 100% Bit-True accuracy (0 mismatches).
coverage_target: cg_qwen_shapes: decode_m1, fallback_m3, prefill_m49, encoder_m64, odd_3d_tail (100%)
Notes: Directly links RTL SystemVerilog simulation results with the 41 real model layers benchmarked on the KR260 board.
Golden_Reference_Rule: 100% bit-exact match with the Golden Model across all 5 shapes.
Bug_Injection_Target: Any boundary calculation bug at M=1, M=3, or M=49 is caught.

Objective: Verify running multiple consecutive jobs with completely different configurations without resetting hardware in between (including inserting an invalid-config job between two valid jobs), as well as aborting a job mid-flight via RST_i=0 and restarting.
Stimulus: Part A (No reset): Run Job 1 (M=16, K=32, N=16, out_mode=01) -> wait for done_o -> run Job 2 with an intentionally invalid config (out_mode=00 -> reports err_o=1, done_o=1) -> run Job 3 (M=3, K=300, N=20, k_dim=64, out_mode=11). Part B (Mid-flight reset): Launch Job 4 (M=64, K=256, N=64), assert RST_i=0 for 5 cycles mid-K-block, flush DMA BFM queues, release RST_i=1, and run Job 5 (M=16, K=64, N=32, out_mode=01).
Checks: Verify in Part A: internal state registers (buf_ready_r, fetch_sel_r, g_sel_r, s2mm_sts_expected_r/received_r, occ_r, raw_wp_r/rp_r, i8_wp_r/rp_r, err_o) reinitialize cleanly on each new start_i pulse, and Job 3 produces 100% accurate results. In Part B: after RST_i=0 all FSMs return to IDLE and Job 5 completes accurately.
Expected_result: Both the Job 1 -> Job 2 (err) -> Job 3 sequence and the Job 4 (abort) -> Job 5 sequence execute flawlessly with zero state leakage across invocations.
Notes: On the KR260 board, every generated token invokes the PL ~96.5 times consecutively without reloading the bitstream or resetting the PL.
Golden_Reference_Rule: Each valid start_i invocation is 100% independent of prior execution history.
Bug_Injection_Target: Forgetting to reset s2mm_sts_expected_r/received_r or buf_ready_r on a new start_i (lines 626, 714, 769) -> Job 2 onward hangs or uses the wrong GBUF slot -> TB reports FAIL.
Pass_Criteria: 100% of valid jobs in the sequence complete properly and match golden.

Category: Integrated System Test (AXI-Lite Regs + Top L2) & Random Stress
Objective: Verify full PL subsystem integration (combining gemm_l2_axi_lite_regs + gemm_top_l2 as connected in Block Design gemm_system.bd) and run 30 comprehensive randomized jobs (randomizing M, K, N, k_dim, strides, out_mode, and back-pressure) controlled entirely via AXI4-Lite transactions and the irq_o interrupt.
Stimulus: Using axil_write() and axil_read() tasks, program registers 0x00..0x3C for 30 randomized jobs driven by seed (+SEED=), write bit 0 = 1 to 0x2C to launch execution, wait for interrupt irq_o == 1, read 0x2C to verify and clear done_sticky, and verify DDR memory (including canary guards around the output matrices).
Checks: Verify the entire software control sequence (programming -> start -> wait irq -> read & clear status -> verify DDR + canary guard) achieves 0 data errors, 0 canary corruptions, 0 SVA errors, and 100% functional coverage.
Expected_result: 30/30 randomized full-PL-system jobs PASS 100%; 100% functional coverage achieved.
Notes: 100% faithful emulation of how the C++ driver kr260_npu_driver.h on the ARM Cortex-A53 CPU interacts with the entire PL subsystem.
